title: Supply-Chain Knowledge Map — contract fixture only
purpose: A deliberately small fixture that tests branch-card provenance and view selection. It is not a selected post topic or operating recommendation.

source_capsule.source_locator: Supply-Chain Opportunity Map v1 — the scope-window contract
source_capsule.supported_paraphrase: The opportunity map narrows one broad area into a bounded reader, work object, decision and claim route; it does not select a public topic or prove an outcome.

source_registry.claim_boundary: This source defines how the map narrows scope. It does not prove a workflow outcome or select a public topic.

decision_questions: What needs to be checked before action?
boundaries_and_exceptions: The signal alone does not decide the outcome.
nodes.not_a_claim: This fixture does not claim that a specific signal causes a business outcome.

nodes.label: A first check (fixture)

branches.label: Signal-to-first-check scope (fixture)

scope_window.reader_moment: A change appears in a normal work queue and needs context before action.
scope_window.decision_or_tension: Name the first check without pretending the signal decides the outcome.
scope_window.reader_payoff: A clearer way to distinguish a signal from the decision it informs.
scope_window.in_scope: The relation between a signal and a first check.
scope_window.out_of_scope: Any company threshold, action, result, or universal recommendation.
scope_window.boundary_or_exception: A real action still needs accountable context outside this fixture.

narrow.label: The signal
narrow.purpose: Keep the reader focused on the operating object before adding any method.

deep.label: The first check
deep.purpose: Show the minimal relation that gives the signal useful context.

wide.label: Declared scope boundary
wide.purpose: Keep the complete declared fixture relation visible without expanding into a taxonomy.

branches.claim_boundary: This branch is an illustrative scope handoff only. It cannot select a topic or claim an operating outcome.

branches.label: Research seed only (fixture)

scope_window.reader_moment: A possible tension appears but has not been researched or validated.
scope_window.decision_or_tension: Decide whether research is warranted before making a public framework.
scope_window.reader_payoff: A clear label that prevents a hunch being mistaken for an operating method.
scope_window.out_of_scope: Any build-ready content direction, outcome claim, or recommendation.
scope_window.boundary_or_exception: No conclusion may be drawn until the underlying relationship is sourced or tested.

narrow.label: The unverified prompt
narrow.purpose: Make the uncertainty visible before it becomes an assumption.

deep.label: The same unverified prompt
deep.purpose: There is no deeper relationship until research adds one.

wide.label: The declared research boundary
wide.purpose: Do not expand uncertainty into a false expertise map.

branches.claim_boundary: This is research-only and cannot enter production as a build-ready card.

notes: Fixture only. It proves the contract can distinguish source-backed scope from a research seed without selecting a content topic.
